latestReview.note: SoL-Refiner MLX 0.1.1 removes artificial input edge limits and uses adaptive 9/17/25/33/41-frame windows. 165 tests passed. Exact signed managed-service installation verified 3840x2160 17-frame output with audio, custom prompts, cancellation, restart and uninstall on Runtime 1.8.7. Same published checkpoint Distributions; no weight download needed for existing users. Requires updated Desktop Host for resource_limited/null pixel capability parsing and media-derived memory reservations. This Package publication does not deploy the Host. 4K probe MLX peak 14.07 GiB; timings are load-dependent and no general image/temporal-quality claim is made. Installer license consent remains enforced.
